title: Fix B1: [V;N] non-zero array-splat zero-fill miscompile in lean_single.sio

root_cause.bug: the fill value V was skipped and slots were unconditionally zero-filled (xor rax; rep stosq), so var a:[i64;8]=[-1;8] produced zeros
root_cause.fix: compile V into rax (movq rax,xmm0 for f64) then rep-stosq; mirrors the already-correct global path emit_global_inits_x86 (line ~7100). Byte-element arrays keep zero-fill (documented remaining gap).

regression.method: A/B run-pass census (509 tests) gen1_orig vs gen1_fixed (same seed, only source differs)
regression.diff: NONE — zero regressions, zero new passes

remaining_gaps_documented: non-zero byte-element ([u8;N]/[i8;N]) splat still zero-fills (kept for safety)
global non-zero splat already correct (verified); a64/ARM local path not modified (x86 deliverable only)
